intent: Describe the new dramatic beat without reanalyzing source footage.

continuity_anchor.character_state: Appearance-only description; no real-person identity claim.
continuity_anchor.wardrobe: Preserve the selected subject's established wardrobe unless an intentional change is named.
continuity_anchor.vehicle_and_props: Preserve silhouettes, materials, rigid geometry, ownership, and contact points.
continuity_anchor.environment: Preserve place, weather, surfaces, screen direction, spatial anchors, and background topology.
continuity_anchor.camera_geometry: Preserve mount, viewpoint, lens family, relative velocity, and framing drift.
continuity_anchor.emotional_state: Continue from the selected causal beat while retaining visible emotional and material history.

shots.subject: Describe the visible subject without naming or inferring a real identity.
shots.action: Describe one physically coherent setup-contact-consequence-recovery arc.
shots.camera: Specify mount, relative velocity, lens family, shake, pan or tilt, and framing drift.
shots.lighting: Specify motivated source direction, contrast, material response, and exposure behavior.
shots.audio: Specify ambience, physical sound effects, score contour, and only approved exact dialogue.

negative_constraints: no wardrobe, prop, or vehicle mutation
no impossible wheel, board, hand, contact, limb, or gravity behavior
no unexplained camera teleport or lens-family mixing
no generated text, logos, subtitles, UI, promotional overlays, or watermarks
no over-smoothed skin, synthetic gloss, or reset material history
